starter:
-- Everyone below Mark Evans (employee 2), at any depth
WITH RECURSIVE org AS (
  SELECT employee_id, first_name, 1 AS depth
  FROM employees
  WHERE manager_id = 2
)
SELECT employee_id, first_name, depth
FROM org
ORDER BY depth, employee_id;
solution:
WITH RECURSIVE org AS (
  SELECT employee_id, first_name, 1 AS depth
  FROM employees
  WHERE manager_id = 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, org.depth + 1
  FROM employees AS e
  JOIN org ON e.manager_id = org.employee_id
)
SELECT employee_id, first_name, depth
FROM org
ORDER BY depth, employee_id;
